title: 主谓结构（SV）
formula: 主语 + 不及物动词（+ 状语）
explanation: 五大句型之一：句子只需要"谁"和"做什么"。动词是不及物的（后面不接宾语），主语一发出动作，句子就完整了。常见错误：把不及物动词硬接宾语（如把 happen 说成 happen an accident）。

examples.en: The rocket launched.
examples.zh: 火箭发射了。

examples.en: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
examples.zh: 星星在夜空中闪烁。

quiz.question: The rocket ___ successfully at noon.
quiz.explain: launch 作不及物动词"发射升空"时不需要宾语，主谓结构即完整。

quiz.question: 下列哪句是标准的主谓结构？
quiz.explain: rise 是不及物动词，主语+谓语即可；"太阳升起"不能用 rise the east。

quiz.question: The sun ___ in the east every morning.
quiz.explain: rise 是不及物动词，主语 sun + 谓语 rises 即完整的 SV 结构，科学规律用一般现在时。

quiz.question: Suddenly, all the lights ___.
quiz.explain: go out（熄灭）是不及物短语动词，后面不能带宾语，主谓结构已完整。

quiz.question: What ___ at the space center last night?
quiz.explain: happen 是不及物动词，不能用被动（was happened ✗），what 本身作主语，后面直接跟谓语。

quiz.question: The baby ___ all night, so everyone looked tired.
quiz.explain: cry 不及物，主语 the baby + 谓语 cried 即完整的 SV 结构，后面不接宾语。

quiz.question: The guests ___ until midnight, so the party felt empty at first.
quiz.explain: 不及物动词的否定用助动词 didn't + 动词原形 arrive，不能把 not 直接粘在动词后。

quiz.question: 下列哪句的动词后不能也不需要宾语？
quiz.explain: smile 是不及物动词，"她笑了"主谓即完整；own/make 都必须有宾语才能成句。

quiz.question: The temperature ___ sharply after sunset.
quiz.explain: drop 作"下降"讲是不及物动词：The temperature dropped，主谓结构，无宾语无被动。

title: 主谓宾结构（SVO）
formula: 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语
explanation: 五大句型之二：动作要有"承受者"。及物动词后面必须带宾语，句子才完整。宾语通常是名词或代词的宾格。判断技巧：问"动词干了什么"，能答上来的就是宾语。

examples.en: The probe collected soil samples.
examples.zh: 探测器采集了土壤样本。

examples.en: Astronauts study the stars.
examples.zh: 宇航员研究星星。

quiz.question: The astronaut ___ the experiment yesterday.
quiz.explain: conduct 是及物动词，直接接宾语 the experiment，主谓宾结构。

quiz.question: Earth ___ around the sun once a year.
quiz.explain: orbit 是及物动词"环绕"，后面直接跟宾语 the sun。

quiz.question: She ___ a letter to her pen pal last night.
quiz.explain: write 直接及物：wrote a letter 是动宾；to her pen pal 只是介词短语修饰，不算双宾。

quiz.question: 哪个句子的动词后带真正的宾语？
quiz.explain: sleep/arrive 是不及物动词不能直接带宾语；discuss 本身及物不需 about；只有 fix the bike 是标准 SVO。

quiz.question: ___ the engineers test the engine yesterday?
quiz.explain: 对过去动作提问用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形：Did the engineers test...？

quiz.question: She ___ her homework before dinner yesterday.
quiz.explain: finish 是及物动词，直接接宾语 her homework；不能用被动 was finished（她不是"被完成"的对象）。

quiz.question: The storm ___ several houses last summer.
quiz.explain: 暴风是施动者、房屋是承受者，主动语态 destroyed + 宾语 several houses，标准 SVO。

quiz.question: 下列哪句的及物动词缺了宾语，句子不完整？
quiz.explain: fix 是及物动词必须带宾语；listen/sleep 不及物，不带宾语反而完整。

quiz.question: My little brother ___ the remote control under the sofa again.
quiz.explain: hide 及物：hid + 宾语 the remote control；was hid 不是正确被动形式（应为 was hidden）。

title: 主系表结构（SVP）
formula: 主语 + 系动词 + 表语
explanation: 五大句型之三：说明主语"是什么/怎么样"。系动词不只是 be：become（变得）、look（看起来）、feel（感觉）、sound（听起来）、remain（保持）等都常作系动词，后面接形容词作表语，而不是副词。

examples.en: Space is silent.
examples.zh: 太空是寂静的。

examples.en: The pilot seemed nervous before the launch.
examples.zh: 发射前飞行员看起来很紧张。

quiz.question: The moonlight looks ___ tonight.
quiz.explain: look 是系动词，后接形容词作表语，不能用副词 beautifully。

quiz.question: Mars ___ red because of iron oxide.
quiz.explain: appear 作系动词"看起来是"，直接接形容词表语。

quiz.question: The soup ___ delicious.
quiz.explain: 感官动词 taste 在这里是系动词，后面接形容词 delicious 作表语，不接副词。

quiz.question: He ___ a teacher for over ten years.
quiz.explain: be 动词表状态，延续用现在完成时 has been；系动词 be 一般不用进行体。

quiz.question: The leaves ___ yellow in autumn.
quiz.explain: turn 是表状态变化的系动词，后直接接形容词 yellow 作表语。

quiz.question: The milk ___ sour — don't drink it!
quiz.explain: go 作系动词表"变质变得"：has gone sour，sour 是形容词表语而非副词。

quiz.question: ___ the weather warm today?
quiz.explain: 系动词 be 构成疑问句直接把 be 提前：Is the weather warm？不需要助动词 does。

quiz.question: The plan ___ practical after the revision.
quiz.explain: sound 系动词 + 形容词 practical 作表语；主语三单加 s，不能用副词 practically。

quiz.question: The answer ___ correct, so he didn't change it.
quiz.explain: 系动词的否定直接在 be 后加 not：isn't correct；系表结构不用 do 助动词否定。

title: 主谓双宾结构（SVOO）
formula: 主语 + 动词 + 间接宾语(人) + 直接宾语(物)
explanation: 五大句型之四：一个动作涉及两个人和物——"给某人某物"。常见双宾动词：give、show、send、offer、tell、teach、buy。两种写法等价：give me a book = give a book to me；buy me a pen = buy a pen for me。

examples.en: The teacher showed the students a star map.
examples.zh: 老师给学生们看了一张星图。

examples.en: Mission control sent the crew a message.
examples.zh: 任务控制中心给机组人员发了一条消息。

quiz.question: Grandpa told the children ___ last night.
quiz.explain: tell 后接双宾：间接宾语 the children（人）在前，直接宾语 a story（物）在后。

quiz.question: NASA offered the young engineer ___
quiz.explain: offer 是典型双宾动词：offer sb. sth.，人是间接宾语，物是直接宾语。

quiz.question: The company ___ each employee a year-end bonus.
quiz.explain: give sb sth 双宾语结构：give + 间接宾语(each employee) + 直接宾语(bonus)，中间不加介词。

quiz.question: Grandma ___ us wonderful stories every summer.
quiz.explain: tell sb sth 是标准双宾结构；say 只能 say sth to sb，speak/talk 后接 to/about。

quiz.question: Mom ___ her a warm sweater last winter.
quiz.explain: buy sb sth 双宾结构：bought + her（人间接宾语）+ sweater（物直接宾语），不加介词。

quiz.question: 下列哪句是正确的双宾结构？
options: The teacher explained the rule to us.
The teacher explained to us it.
The teacher explained us the rule.
quiz.explain: explain 不能接双宾，必须说 explain sth to sb；类似还有 suggest、describe、report。

quiz.question: I'll ___ you the photos as soon as I get back.
quiz.explain: send sb sth：send + you + the photos，双宾之间不加任何介词。

quiz.question: The manager ___ the team a new project last week.
quiz.explain: assign sb sth 双宾：assigned + the team（人）+ a project（物）。

quiz.question: He drew his niece ___ for her birthday.
quiz.explain: draw sb sth：drew his niece（人间接宾语）+ a picture（直接宾语）。

title: 主谓宾补结构（SVOC）
formula: 主语 + 动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语
explanation: 五大句型之五：宾语后面还要"补"一句，说明宾语的状态或身份。常见结构：call it a day、find the room clean、keep the door open、make him happy。判断技巧：宾语和补语之间加个 be 仍然说得通（the door is open）。

examples.en: We call the planet the Red Planet.
examples.zh: 我们把那颗行星叫做红色星球。

examples.en: Zero gravity keeps the food floating.
examples.zh: 零重力让食物漂浮着。

quiz.question: The news made everyone ___.
quiz.explain: make + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补：make everyone excited。

quiz.question: Scientists named the new asteroid ___ after its discoverer.
quiz.explain: name + 宾语 + 名词作宾补：name the asteroid Bennu（把它命名为贝努）。

quiz.question: The news made everyone ___ sad.
quiz.explain: make sb do sth：使役动词后接不带 to 的不定式作宾语补足语。

quiz.question: We elected her ___ of the club.
quiz.explain: elect sb + 职位名词 作宾语补足语，表独一无二职位时不加冠词。

quiz.question: Keep the door ___ while the heater is on.
quiz.explain: keep + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补：keep the door open（门保持开着的状态），过去分词 opened 强调动作而非状态。

quiz.question: We found the box ___ after moving day.
quiz.explain: find + 宾语 + 形容词：found the box empty，宾语与补语之间可加 be（the box was empty）说得通。

quiz.question: They painted the fence ___ to match the flowers.
quiz.explain: paint + 宾语 + 颜色形容词作宾补：painted the fence green。

quiz.question: The coach had us ___ five laps before practice.
quiz.explain: have sb do sth：使役动词 have 后接不带 to 的不定式作宾补。

quiz.question: I saw him ___ the street when the light turned red.
quiz.explain: see sb do sth：感官动词后接不带 to 的不定式，宾补用动词原形 cross。

title: 一般现在时
formula: 主语 + 动词原形（第三人称单数加 -s/-es）
explanation: 表示经常性、习惯性的动作或客观事实。关键：三单主语（he/she/it/单数名词）动词加 s/es。地球绕太阳转这种永恒事实用一般现在时。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: Light travels at about 300,000 km per second.
examples.zh: 光以每秒约30万公里的速度传播。

quiz.question: He ___ to school every day.
quiz.explain: 主语第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s/-es。

quiz.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
quiz.explain: 客观事实用一般现在时；water 是三单，动词加 -s。

quiz.question: The space station ___ the earth every 90 minutes.
quiz.explain: regular 常规动作 + 三单主语，用 circles。

quiz.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
quiz.explain: 科学事实与自然规律属于"恒常现在"，用一般现在时。

quiz.question: He ___ like spicy food at all.
quiz.explain: 三单主语的否定用 doesn't + 动词原形：doesn't like。

quiz.question: ___ your brother play the guitar?
quiz.explain: 主语 your brother 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does + 主语 + 动词原形。

quiz.question: The museum ___ at nine every morning except Mondays.
quiz.explain: 三单主语 the museum + 习惯性动作，一般现在时动词加 -s：opens。

quiz.question: My grandparents ___ in the countryside and seldom come to the city.
quiz.explain: 主语 grandparents 是复数，动词用原形 live；长期住处用一般现在时而非进行时。

quiz.question: Sound ___ much slower than light.
quiz.explain: 客观事实用一般现在时；主语 sound 不可数名词按三单处理，动词加 -s。

title: 现在进行时
formula: 主语 + am/is/are + 动词-ing
explanation: 表示此刻正在进行的动作。结构是"be 动词 + 现在分词"，两者缺一不可。常见偏误：漏掉 be（He studying ✗）或忘记动词加 -ing。

examples.en: The astronauts are conducting an experiment right now.
examples.zh: 宇航员们此刻正在做实验。

examples.en: Look! The comet is passing close to Earth.
examples.zh: 看！彗星正从近地经过。

quiz.question: Be quiet! The signal ___.
quiz.explain: "此时此刻"用进行时：is coming。

quiz.question: They ___ a new space suit this week.
quiz.explain: this week 正在进行的临时动作用现在进行时。

quiz.question: Look! The astronauts ___ the hatch.
quiz.explain: Look! 是"此刻正在发生"的信号词，用现在进行时。

quiz.question: These days I ___ for a marathon, so I'm always tired.
quiz.explain: these days 表示"现阶段持续进行的活动"，用现在进行时表达临时习惯。

quiz.question: They ___ waiting in line — they just left the hall.
quiz.explain: 进行时的否定在 be 后加 not：they aren't waiting，主语复数用 aren't。

quiz.question: ___ your parents watching the news right now?
quiz.explain: 进行时的疑问把 be 提前：Are your parents watching...？

quiz.question: Listen! Someone ___ the piano downstairs.
quiz.explain: Listen! 表"此刻正在发生"，用现在进行时 is playing。

quiz.question: The chef ___ the sauce right now, so keep the fire low.
quiz.explain: right now 是进行时信号词：is stirring。

quiz.question: I ___ for my final exams this month, so the library is my second home.
quiz.explain: this month 表现阶段持续进行的活动，用现在进行时 am preparing。

title: 现在完成时
formula: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
explanation: 表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响，或从过去持续到现在的状态。标志词：already、yet、just、ever、never、so far、for + 时间段、since + 时间点。不要和"具体的过去时间（yesterday 等）"连用。

examples.en: Humans have landed on the moon six times.
examples.zh: 人类已经登上过月球六次。

examples.en: She has studied English for ten years.
examples.zh: 她已经学了十年英语。

quiz.question: The rover ___ on Mars since 2021.
quiz.explain: since + 过去时间点 + 持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时。

quiz.question: I ___ never seen a total solar eclipse before.
quiz.explain: never/ever 等标志词要求现在完成时：have never seen。

quiz.question: She ___ just ___ back from the space center.
quiz.explain: just 表"刚刚完成"，主语三单用 has + 过去分词 come（come 的过去分词是 come 不是 came）。

quiz.question: I ___ this movie three times already.
quiz.explain: already + 次数 three times，表示"过去动作对现在的累计影响"，是典型现在完成时。

quiz.question: She ___ in Beijing since 2018.
quiz.explain: since 2018 + 延续性动词，从过去持续到现在的状态用现在完成时 has lived。

quiz.question: ___ you ever tried Japanese food?
quiz.explain: ever 是现在完成时标志词：Have you ever tried...？

quiz.question: He ___ his keys, so he can't open the door now.
quiz.explain: 丢钥匙的动作在过去，但"现在进不了门"是它对现在的影响 — 典型现在完成时 has lost。

quiz.question: Tom isn't here — he ___ to the bank.
quiz.explain: has gone to 表示"去了还没回来"；has been to 表示"去过已回来"。人不在这里，用 has gone。

quiz.question: The train ___ already left the station.
quiz.explain: already 表已完成动作对现在的影响；主语 the train 三单，用 has + 过去分词。

title: 一般过去时
formula: 主语 + 动词过去式（规则加 -ed，不规则需记忆）
explanation: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或状态，与现在无关。规则动词加 -ed；常用不规则动词要单独记（go-went-gone、see-saw-seen）。常与 yesterday、last week、in 1969 等过去时间连用。

examples.en: Apollo 11 landed on the moon in 1969.
examples.zh: 阿波罗11号于1969年登上月球。

examples.en: We saw a shooting star last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚看到了一颗流星。

quiz.question: The team ___ the signal two hours ago.
quiz.explain: two hours ago 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 lost。

quiz.question: He ___ to the space museum last Sunday.
quiz.explain: last Sunday 指明过去，go 的过去式是 went。

quiz.question: I ___ my keys yesterday, so I couldn't get in.
quiz.explain: yesterday 是明确的过去时间点；事件已结束并连锁影响过去的 couldn't，用一般过去时。

quiz.question: — When ___ the package arrive? — This morning.
quiz.explain: 对过去时间提问：did + 主语 + 动词原形。

quiz.question: We ___ any money on the trip because everything was free.
quiz.explain: 过去否定：didn't + 动词原形 spend，不能写成 didn't spent。

quiz.question: They ___ the summit before sunrise last Saturday.
quiz.explain: last Saturday 是明确过去时间，动作用一般过去时 reached。

quiz.question: She ___ up at six and went jogging this morning.
quiz.explain: this morning（已过去的早晨）+ and 连接的并列动作用过去式 woke。

quiz.question: — Who ___ the window? — Tom did, and he has apologized.
quiz.explain: 提问过去的动作：Who broke...？过去事件本身用一般过去时 broke。

quiz.question: The little boy ___ his first word when he was ten months old.
quiz.explain: 说（出）某句话用 say 的过去式 said；speak 后一般接语言而非具体的话。

title: 被动语态
formula: 主语(受动者) + be + 过去分词（+ by 施动者）
explanation: 当"受动者"比"施动者"更重要时用被动。时态变化体现在 be 上：一般现在 is done、过去 was done、现在完成 has been done、将来 will be done。中文"被、由、受到"常对应英文被动。

examples.en: The satellite was launched by a heavy rocket.
examples.zh: 这颗卫星是由一枚重型火箭发射的。

examples.en: The data is transmitted to Earth every hour.
examples.zh: 数据每小时被传回地球。

quiz.question: The telescope ___ into orbit next month.
quiz.explain: 望远镜是"被发射"的对象，将来被动：will be sent。

quiz.question: English ___ all over the world.
quiz.explain: 英语"被说"，一般现在被动：is spoken。

quiz.question: The samples ___ already ___ to the lab.
quiz.explain: 现在完成被动 = have been + 过去分词；already 夹在中间。

quiz.question: The bridge ___ by the storm last week.
quiz.explain: 桥是被毁的对象，last week 过去时：was + destroyed（过去分词）。

quiz.question: The old temple ___ in the 1990s and still looks new.
quiz.explain: 庙是被重建的对象，in the 1990s 过去时；主语 temple 单数，was + 过去分词 rebuilt。

quiz.question: ___ the letter sent yesterday?
quiz.explain: 被动语态的疑问把 be 提前：Was the letter sent...？letter 单数用 was。

quiz.question: The machine ___ repaired by the engineer right now.
quiz.explain: 情态动词被动：must + be + 过去分词，机器是"被修理"的对象。

quiz.question: A new bridge across the river ___ right now.
quiz.explain: 现在进行被动 = is/are being + 过去分词：桥正在被建造，is being built。

quiz.question: These photos ___ without permission, so the website took them down.
quiz.explain: 照片是被发布的一方，复数主语用 were + 过去分词 published。

title: 情态动词
formula: 主语 + can/may/must/should/... + 动词原形
explanation: can（能/会）、may（可以/可能）、must（必须）、should（应该）、need（需要）表示能力、许可、义务和推测。三条铁律：后面永远接动词原形；本身没有人称变化（he can，不是 he cans）；否定直接加 not（cannot、shouldn't）。must 表推测的否定是 can't（不可能），不是 mustn't。

examples.en: Astronauts must wear space suits outside the station.
examples.zh: 宇航员在空间站外必须穿宇航服。

examples.en: You can see Venus with the naked eye tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚你用肉眼就能看到金星。

quiz.question: You ___ smoke in the space station. It is forbidden.
quiz.explain: 表示绝对禁止用 mustn't；needn't/don't have to 意思是"不必"，语气完全不同。

quiz.question: He ___ play the piano when he was five.
quiz.explain: 过去的能力用 can 的过去式 could；情态动词后接动词原形不受时态影响，但主句讲过去要用 could。

quiz.question: That ___ be Tom — he has flown to Beijing.
quiz.explain: 表否定推测"不可能"用 can't，mustn't 不表推测。

quiz.question: You ___ be tired after the long flight—go rest.
quiz.explain: must 表"有把握的推测"（一定很累），否定推测用 can't（不可能）。

quiz.question: You ___ finish the report today — tomorrow is fine.
quiz.explain: "不必"用 don't have to / needn't；mustn't 是"绝对禁止"，语气完全不同。

quiz.question: ___ I use your phone for a minute?
quiz.explain: 请求许可用 May/Can I...？must 表义务不能用于请求许可。

quiz.question: — Must I hand it in right now? — No, you ___.
quiz.explain: must 提问的否定回答是 needn't/don't have to（不必），不是 mustn't（禁止）。

quiz.question: He ___ speak three languages by the age of ten.
quiz.explain: 过去的能力用 could；by the age of ten 指过去时间点。

quiz.question: You ___ see a doctor if the pain continues for a week.
quiz.explain: 提出建议"应该"用 should；would 表意愿，might 表较小可能。

title: 定语从句
formula: 名词 + 关系代词(who/which/that/whose) + 从句
explanation: 定语从句像形容词一样修饰前面的名词（先行词）。who 指人、which 指物、that 人物皆可、whose 表"谁的"。关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省略。注意：which/who 不指时间地点；先行词是时间用 when，地点用 where。

examples.en: The satellite that we built is still working.
examples.zh: 我们造的那颗卫星仍在工作。

examples.en: He is the scientist who discovered the comet.
examples.zh: 他就是发现那颗彗星的科学家。

quiz.question: This is the rocket ___ carried the crew to the ISS.
quiz.explain: 先行词 rocket 是物，用 that/which；who 只指人。

quiz.question: Do you remember the day ___ we visited the observatory?
quiz.explain: 先行词是时间 the day，且关系词在从句中作时间状语，用 when。

quiz.question: The engineer ___ design won the award works here.
quiz.explain: "谁的（设计）"用 whose 引导定语从句。

quiz.question: The engineer ___ designed the bridge won an award.
quiz.explain: 先行词是人(engineer)且在从句中作主语，用 who；whom 只作宾语。

quiz.question: This is the village ___ I spent my childhood.
quiz.explain: 先行词 village 是地点，且关系词在从句中作地点状语（spent my childhood in the village），用 where。

quiz.question: The girl ___ umbrella was stolen is waiting at the lost-and-found.
quiz.explain: "谁的伞"表所属关系，用 whose 引导定语从句。

quiz.question: The colleague ___ I share an office is very kind.
quiz.explain: 从句完整结构是 I share an office with the colleague，介词 with 提前用 with whom。

quiz.question: The Great Wall, ___ attracts millions of visitors every year, is over 20,000 km long.
quiz.explain: 逗号隔开的非限制性定语从句不能用 that，先行词是物用 which。

quiz.question: The movie ___ we watched last night was fantastic.
quiz.explain: 先行词 movie 是物，关系代词在从句中作宾语，用 which/that（what 不能引导定语从句）。

title: 宾语从句
formula: 主句 + that/if/whether/特殊疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语
explanation: 宾语从句作主句动词的宾语，核心规则是"陈述语序"：连接词后必须用"主语 + 谓语"，不能颠倒（不是 I don't know where is he，而是 I don't know where he is）。that 无实义常可省略；表"是否"用 if 或 whether。

examples.en: I believe that we will reach Mars one day.
examples.zh: 我相信总有一天我们会登上火星。

examples.en: She asked whether the launch had been delayed.
examples.zh: 她问发射是否被推迟了。

quiz.question: I don't know ___.
quiz.explain: 宾语从句用陈述语序：连接词 + 主语 + 谓语。

quiz.question: The teacher asked ___ the earth moves around the sun.
quiz.explain: 表"是否"的一般疑问句作宾语从句，用 if/whether 引导。

quiz.question: Could you tell me ___?
quiz.explain: 特殊疑问句变宾语从句要去掉助动词，改回陈述语序。

quiz.question: I wonder ___ the store is still open.
quiz.explain: wonder 表示疑问，宾语从句用 whether/if 引导，不用 that。

quiz.question: She said she ___ tired after the double shift.
quiz.explain: 主句 said 是过去时，宾语从句时态呼应用过去时 was（现在仍累才用 is）。

quiz.question: I'm not sure ___ he will join us or not.
quiz.explain: 与 or not 直接连用时用 whether，不用 if。

quiz.question: Do you know ___ the nearest bank is?
quiz.explain: 从句缺地点状语，用 where 引导并保持陈述语序 where the nearest bank is。

quiz.question: Nobody knows ___ broke the window.
quiz.explain: 从句缺主语（谁打破了窗户），用主格 who；whom 只能作宾语。

quiz.question: I don't think ___ the plan will work.
quiz.explain: think/believe 后接陈述内容用 that（常省略）；whether 只用于"是否"。

title: 状语从句
formula: 主句 + when/if/because/although/so...that + 从句
explanation: 状语从句修饰动词，说明时间、条件、原因、让步、结果等。最重要的规则："主将从现"——主句用将来时，时间/条件从句（when、if、as soon as、until）用一般现在时表将来。

examples.en: When the signal arrives, we will decode it.
examples.zh: 信号一到我们就会解码它。

examples.en: Although the rocket is huge, it weighs less than you think.
examples.zh: 虽然火箭很大，但它比你想象的要轻。

quiz.question: If it ___ tomorrow, the launch will be postponed.
quiz.explain: if 引导条件从句遵循"主将从现"：主句 will be，从句用一般现在时。

quiz.question: He stayed up late ___ he could watch the eclipse.
quiz.explain: so that 表目的"为了"；because 表原因，逻辑不通。

quiz.question: ___ the task was difficult, nobody gave up.
quiz.explain: "虽然难但没人放弃"是让步关系，用 although。

quiz.question: ___ it rains tomorrow, the picnic will be canceled.
quiz.explain: 真实条件句用 if：条件满足 → 主句结果发生（主将从现）。

quiz.question: I'll call you as soon as I ___ the airport.
quiz.explain: as soon as 时间从句遵循"主将从现"：主句 will call，从句用一般现在时 reach。

quiz.question: The teacher spoke slowly ___ everyone could follow.
quiz.explain: so that 表目的"为了让大家都能跟上"；as if 表"好像"，in case 表"以防"。

quiz.question: He has been quiet ___ his dog died last month.
quiz.explain: since 表"自从"：自狗去世后他一直很安静，主句用完成时/延续状态。

quiz.question: Take your umbrella ___ it rains on the way.
quiz.explain: in case 表"以防（万一）"：带伞是为了防备下雨，雨还没下。

quiz.question: ___ hard he tried, he couldn't open the jar.
quiz.explain: however + 形容词/副词 = no matter how，表让步"无论多努力"。

title: 形容词比较级与最高级
formula: 比较级 + than / the + 最高级 + (in/of 范围)
explanation: 两者比较用比较级（加 -er 或 more），三者以上用最高级（加 -est 或 most，前面加 the）。规则：单音节词加 -er/-est（big-bigger-biggest）；多音节词用 more/most（more expensive）；以 y 结尾双音节词变 y 为 ier（easy-easier）。注意 than 后接比较对象。

examples.en: Mars is smaller than Earth.
examples.zh: 火星比地球小。

examples.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
examples.zh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

quiz.question: This launch was ___ than the last one.
quiz.explain: 多音节形容词用 more 构成比较级，且 than 前后比较的是名词性质。

quiz.question: The sun is ___ object in our sky.
quiz.explain: 范围内独一无二用最高级，bright 是单音节词加 -est，最高级前加 the。

quiz.question: Travelling to Mars is far ___ than to the moon.
quiz.explain: difficult 是多音节词，比较级用 more difficult；far 修饰比较级加强语气。

quiz.question: This is ___ movie I have ever seen.
quiz.explain: ever 划定比较范围（所有看过的电影），用最高级 the best。

quiz.question: The weather is getting ___ and ___.
quiz.explain: 比较级 + and + 比较级表"越来越…"；hot 单音节双写 t 加 -er。

quiz.question: I feel much ___ today than yesterday.
quiz.explain: well 的比较级是 better（不规则变化）；much 修饰比较级加强程度。

quiz.question: This film is ___ exciting as that one.
quiz.explain: 同级比较用 as + 形容词原级 + as。

quiz.question: Lucy is ___ of the two sisters.
quiz.explain: 两者中"较…的那一个"用 the + 比较级：the taller of the two；最高级用于三者以上。

quiz.question: Of all the students, Tom writes ___.
quiz.explain: 多音节副词最高级用 most + 副词：writes most carefully（修饰动作用副词）。

title: 动词不定式
formula: to + 动词原形（作目的/宾语/宾补/定语）
explanation: 不定式 to do 是"非谓语"——句子已经有一个谓语了，第二个动词要用非谓语形式。不定式常表目的（"为了"）和未发生的动作。固定搭配需记：want to do、decide to do、hope to do、tell sb. to do、it takes sb. time to do。

examples.en: She trained for years to become an astronaut.
examples.zh: 她训练了多年，为的是成为宇航员。

examples.en: It takes eight months to reach Mars.
examples.zh: 到达火星需要八个月。

quiz.question: He went to the observatory ___ the comet.
quiz.explain: 表目的"为了观测"用不定式 to observe。

quiz.question: We decided ___ the mission a second chance.
quiz.explain: decide 后固定接 to do，不接 doing。

quiz.question: The captain told the crew ___ ready.
quiz.explain: tell sb. to do sth.，宾补用不定式。

quiz.question: He stopped ___ a break after three hours of coding.
quiz.explain: stop to do = 停下手头的事去做另一件事；stop doing = 停止正在做的事。

quiz.question: It's important ___ a second language.
quiz.explain: It's + 形容词 + to do：不定式作真正主语，it 是形式主语。

quiz.question: I don't know ___ to solve the problem.
quiz.explain: 疑问词 + 不定式：how to solve（怎么解决），know 后不能接 that + 不定式。

quiz.question: He is old enough ___ to school by himself.
quiz.explain: enough + 名词/形容词 + to do：old enough to go，不定式表结果。

quiz.question: My dream is ___ a pilot one day.
quiz.explain: dream/goal/plan 等名词的表语多用不定式 to become，表示"想要实现的"。

quiz.question: She was the first woman ___ that mountain.
quiz.explain: the first/last/only + 名词后用不定式作后置定语：the first woman to climb。

title: 动名词
formula: 动词-ing（作主语/宾语/介词后）
explanation: 动名词 doing 把动作名词化，可以当名词用：作主语（Swimming is fun）、作宾语、介词后必须用动名词（be good at doing、instead of doing）。接动名词的动词口诀：enjoy、finish、mind、avoid、practice、suggest、keep（doing）。与不定式的区别：动名词偏"已发生/一般性"，不定式偏"未发生/一次性"。

examples.en: Floating in space is an amazing experience.
examples.zh: 在太空中漂浮是一种奇妙的体验。

examples.en: He finished checking the engine at midnight.
examples.zh: 他午夜时检查完了发动机。

quiz.question: I look forward to ___ from you.
quiz.explain: to 在这里是介词（look forward to），后面必须接动名词 hearing。

quiz.question: Would you mind ___ the window? It is hot.
quiz.explain: mind 固定接 doing。

quiz.question: ___ up early is good for your health.
quiz.explain: 句首作主语用动名词 Getting（表一般性习惯）。

quiz.question: ___ early is hard in winter.
quiz.explain: 动名词短语 Getting up 作主语，谓语 is 用单数。

quiz.question: He is good at ___ problems quickly.
quiz.explain: 介词 at 后必须用动名词：be good at solving。

quiz.question: Thank you for ___ me the message in time.
quiz.explain: 介词 for 后用动名词 sending。

quiz.question: She avoided ___ about the accident.
quiz.explain: avoid 属于"接动名词"的动词：avoid doing sth。

quiz.question: We're considering ___ to another city next year.
quiz.explain: consider 接动名词：consider moving，表示"考虑做某事"。

quiz.question: Instead of ___ TV, he read a book every evening.
quiz.explain: instead of 是介词短语，of 后必须用动名词 watching。

title: 现在分词与过去分词
formula: doing（主动/进行）/ done（被动/完成）
explanation: 分词作定语或状语时，选 doing 还是 done 取决于它与被修饰词的关系："主动、进行"用现在分词（the rising sun 正在升起的太阳）；"被动、完成"用过去分词（a launched satellite 已被发射的卫星）。一句话口诀：人 amusing、物 amused 不成立——英语用-ing 形容物（a boring book 令人无聊的书），用-ed 形容人（I am bored 我感到无聊）。

examples.en: Seen from space, the earth looks like a blue marble.
examples.zh: 从太空看去，地球像一颗蓝色弹珠。

examples.en: The falling star lit up the sky.
examples.zh: 那颗坠落的星星照亮了天空。

quiz.question: ___ from the moon, the earth rises over the horizon.
quiz.explain: 地球是"被看"，分词逻辑主语与主句主语一致，用过去分词 Seen。

quiz.question: The movie about black holes was really ___.
quiz.explain: 修饰"令人兴奋的事物"用 -ing 形容词 exciting。

quiz.question: The ___ audience stood up and cheered.
quiz.explain: 观众"感到"兴奋，修饰人用 -ed 形容词 excited。

quiz.question: The children were ___ by the clown's tricks.
quiz.explain: 人"被逗乐"用过去分词 amused；amusing（令人发笑的）修饰事物。

quiz.question: The ___ glass on the floor cut his finger.
quiz.explain: 玻璃是"被打破的"，过去分词 broken 作定语表被动完成。

quiz.question: ___ the bad news, she burst into tears.
quiz.explain: 她主动"听到"消息，现在分词 Hearing 作原因状语，逻辑主语与主句一致。

quiz.question: I had my bike ___ yesterday at the corner shop.
quiz.explain: have sth done：车是"被修"的，用过去分词 repaired 表被动。

quiz.question: It was a ___ journey — everyone fell asleep on the way.
quiz.explain: 旅程"令人疲惫"用 -ing 形容词 tiring 修饰物；tired 形容人"感到疲惫"。

quiz.question: The coach's speech was so ___ that nobody dozed off.
quiz.explain: 演讲"令人受鼓舞"用 inspiring；inspired 形容人"感到鼓舞"。

title: 虚拟语气
formula: If + 过去式, would + 动词原形（与现在事实相反）
explanation: 表达"不可能或与事实相反"的假设。与现在事实相反：从句用过去式（be 一律用 were），主句用 would/could/might + 原形。与过去事实相反：从句用 had done，主句用 would have done。记住：if I were you 是固定说法，不说 was。

examples.en: If I were an astronaut, I would live on the space station.
examples.zh: 如果我是宇航员，我就住在空间站上。

examples.en: If humans had better rockets, they would travel faster.
examples.zh: 如果人类有更好的火箭，就能旅行得更快。

quiz.question: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
quiz.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气中，be 一律用 were。

quiz.question: If he ___ the alarm, he would have missed the launch.
quiz.explain: 与过去事实相反：从句用 had + 过去分词。

quiz.question: She would fly to Mars if she ___ enough money.
quiz.explain: 与现在事实相反：if 从句用过去式 had，主句用 would。

quiz.question: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
quiz.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟：If I were you...（虚拟语气中 be 一律用 were）。

quiz.question: If she had left earlier, she ___ the storm.
quiz.explain: 与过去事实相反：从句 had left，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

quiz.question: I wish I ___ how to dance.
quiz.explain: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟：与现在相反用过去式 knew。

quiz.question: He talks as if he ___ everything about space.
quiz.explain: as if 表"与事实相反的假设"，从句用过去式 knew 虚拟。

quiz.question: If it ___ for your help, we would have failed.
quiz.explain: 与过去相反的虚拟从句用 had + 过去分词：If it hadn't been for...（要不是…）。

quiz.question: Without gravity, everything ___ off the ground.
quiz.explain: without 引出隐含条件"如果没有重力"，与现在事实相反，主句用 would + 原形。

title: There be 句型
formula: There + be动词 + 名词（+ 地点/时间状语）
explanation: 表示"某地/某时有某人某物"。be 动词与它后面的名词保持数的一致：There is a star / There are two stars。时态可变：There was/will be/has been。否定在名词前加 no 或 not any。注意：There be 后不能再出现主语的同位重复（There is a man stands there ✗ → There is a man standing there）。

examples.en: There are billions of stars in our galaxy.
examples.zh: 我们星系中有数十亿颗恒星。

examples.en: There is no air on the moon.
examples.zh: 月球上没有空气。

quiz.question: There ___ a rocket and two satellites on the launch pad.
quiz.explain: There be 的就近原则：be 与最近的名词 a rocket 一致，用单数 is。

quiz.question: There ___ many changes in space technology since 2000.
quiz.explain: since 2000 要求现在完成时，主语 changes 是复数：have been。

quiz.question: ___ a lot of changes in this city since 2010.
quiz.explain: since 2010 与现在完成连用：there have been changes。

quiz.question: There ___ two apples and an orange on the table.
quiz.explain: there be 遵循就近原则：最近的名词 two apples 是复数 → are。

quiz.question: There ___ a meeting in the main hall tomorrow afternoon.
quiz.explain: There be 的将来时是 there will be；不能说 there will have。

quiz.question: There ___ any milk left in the fridge.
quiz.explain: There be 否定：There isn't any milk（milk 不可数按单数），不用 has/have。

quiz.question: There ___ a big tree here when I was a kid.
quiz.explain: 过去某地有某物用 there was/were；a big tree 单数用 was。

quiz.question: There ___ something wrong with my bike these days.
quiz.explain: There seems to be 表"似乎有"：seem 后接 to be，主语 something 单数加 s。

quiz.question: There is little time left, ___?
quiz.explain: 反意疑问句遵循"前否后肯"：little 表否定，后半用肯定 is there。

title: 祈使句与感叹句
formula: 祈使句：动词原形开头 / 感叹句：What + 名词短语！How + 形容词/副词！
explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，主语 you 省略，表请求、命令、建议（否定：Don't + 动词原形）。感叹句两种框架：What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词（What a bright star!）；How + 形容词/副词（How fast it moves!）。注意 what 后接名词、how 后接形容词，别混。

examples.en: Don't touch the controls during the launch.
examples.zh: 发射期间不要碰控制台。

examples.en: What a magnificent view of the galaxy!
examples.zh: 多么壮丽的星系景象啊！

quiz.question: ___ fast the rocket is climbing!
quiz.explain: 感叹形容词 fast 用 How 引导。

quiz.question: ___ exciting news about the Mars mission!
quiz.explain: news 是不可数名词，用 What + 形容词 + 名词，不加 a。

quiz.question: ___ forget to fasten your seat belt.
quiz.explain: 祈使句的否定在动词原形前加 Don't。

quiz.question: ___ carefully before you cross the road!
quiz.explain: 祈使句以动词原形开头，主语 you 省略。

quiz.question: ___ quiet in the reading room, please!
quiz.explain: 祈使句以动词原形开头：Be quiet!（系动词祈使也用原形 be）。

quiz.question: ___ a lovely baby she has!
quiz.explain: 感叹可数名词单数用 What a + 形容词 + 名词：What a lovely baby!

quiz.question: ___ time flies!
quiz.explain: How + 主谓 结构感叹动词/副词快慢：How time flies!（时光飞逝）。

quiz.question: Let's not ___ about it anymore.
quiz.explain: Let's + 动词原形；否定 Let's not + 动词原形 talk。

quiz.question: ___ an interesting story it is!
quiz.explain: story 是可数名词单数且 interesting 以元音开头：What an interesting story!
